labels: Data Labels are required for training

layout.arrangement: White slide with a thin red/maroon double border frame. A gray header strip runs across the top with a yellow circle containing the slide number '37' at the top-right. Centered near the top is a dark red rectangular box with the title. Two curved red arrows branch downward from the title box to two colored boxes side by side: a blue box on the left ('Supervised Learning') and a green box on the right ('Unsuepervised Learning'). Beneath each colored box is a black bold caption line.

Under the blue box: black bold text 'Data Labels are required for training'. Under the green box: black bold text 'No Need for Data Labels' with second line '(A.K.A Clustering)'.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Draw a thin double red/maroon (#B03040) rectangular border around the full slide. 3. Add a light gray (#D3D3D3) horizontal strip across the top (~10% height). 4. In the top-right of the strip, draw a yellow (#F5E96B) circle with a dark outline and place black text '37' inside. 5. Centered near the top (~20-35% height), draw a dark red (#8B0000) rectangle; add white bold sans-serif text on two lines: 'Main Classification' / 'Learning Approaches'. 6. From the bottom-center of the red box, draw two thin red (#CC0000) curved arrows with downward arrowheads, one curving left-down and one right-down. 7. Middle-left: draw a blue (#0000CC) rectangle with white bold text 'Supervised Learning'. 8. Middle-right: draw a green (#1E8C3A) rectangle with white bold text 'Unsuepervised Learning' (preserve the typo exactly). 9. Below the blue box, add black bold text 'Data Labels are required for training'. 10. Below the green box, add black bold text on two lines: 'No Need for Data Labels' / '(A.K.A Clustering)'. 11. Ensure arrows connect the red title box to the tops of the blue and green boxes.
